question: Your best weapon is...

answers.text: Wisdom and negotiation — I always seek a peaceful solution
A sword or blaster — strength decides everything

question: When a friend betrayed you, you...

answers.text: Give them another chance and try to understand why
Never forgive. Betrayal deserves no mercy

question: You were falsely accused. You...

answers.text: Stay calm and prove your innocence through legitimate means
Take justice into your own hands, regardless of consequences

question: What does power mean to you?

answers.text: Responsibility toward those I protect
A tool to achieve my goals at any cost

question: You found a treasure that belongs to others. You...

answers.text: Return it to the owners — it's obviously the right thing
Keep it — finders keepers

question: Your enemy is defeated and defenseless. You...

answers.text: Let them live — killing a helpless enemy is not a victory
Finish it — they wouldn't have spared me

question: When you feel anger, you...

answers.text: Breathe deeply and let it go — anger clouds the mind
Let the anger fuel me — it's my power source

question: The most important thing in life is...

answers.text: Balance, harmony, and connection with loved ones
Strength, ambition, and achieving your goals

question: You're offered unlimited power, but must betray a friend. You...

answers.text: Refuse. No power is worth betrayal
Accept. Emotions are weakness — power is everything

question: What do 'rules' mean to you?

answers.text: The foundation of society — without them comes chaos
Limitations for the weak — the strong make their own rules

question: The galaxy is in danger, but the mission is deadly. You...

answers.text: Go anyway — some things matter more than survival
Assess the odds and look for a safer path first

question: You've been captured by enemies. Your first thought?

answers.text: Find a way to escape and warn my allies
Figure out what they want — and use that

question: Your commander orders an attack on a civilian city. You...

answers.text: Refuse the order and protect the civilians
Follow orders — discipline above all in wartime

question: The only way to stop evil is to become it. You...

answers.text: Find another way — the ends don't justify the means
Do what's needed — results matter more than methods

question: You can save one or many, but not all. You...

answers.text: Save as many as possible and bear the weight of loss
Save whoever is most strategically important

question: If you could feel the Force, how would you use it?

answers.text: To protect the weak and maintain peace
To achieve my own goals and dominate

question: The Jedi forbid attachments. Your opinion?

answers.text: Wise — love leads to fear of loss and darkness
Cruel — depriving people of love is unnatural

question: The Sith say: 'Through strength I gain victory'. You...

answers.text: Disagree — true strength is in self-control, not domination
Agree — weakness deserves contempt, only strength is respected

question: The Jedi Code or the Sith Code — which is closer to you?

answers.text: Jedi — peace, knowledge, harmony, the Force
Sith — passion, power, victory, freedom

question: Your master is wrong and jeopardizes the mission. You...

answers.text: Speak up honestly — even masters can be wrong
Act independently — waiting for advice is too dangerous

question: Lying to save innocents is...

answers.text: Justified — moral flexibility is sometimes necessary
Irrelevant — I tell the truth always, regardless of consequences

question: A criminal who did good deeds to survive. You...

answers.text: Consider the context — a person is more than their acts
The law is the law — a crime remains a crime

question: Someone you love committed a terrible crime. You...

answers.text: Painfully turn them in — justice above all
Protect and help them escape — loyalty over law

question: You learned a terrible truth that will shatter someone's happiness. You...

answers.text: Tell the truth — even painful truth is better than a happy lie
Stay silent — why destroy someone's happiness for 'truth'?

question: You're allowed to do evil for the 'greater good'. You...

answers.text: Refuse — a path to good cannot be built on evil
Agree — great goals require difficult sacrifices

question: How do you treat those weaker than you?

answers.text: Protect and support them — strength is given to defend
Respect only those who earn it through strength

question: You can get everything you want through dishonesty. You...

answers.text: Refuse — the journey matters more than the reward
Take it — results justify the means

question: Your favorite negotiation tactic?

answers.text: Mutual benefit and honesty — that's how relationships are built
Pressure and dominance — the weak always concede first

question: When you make a mistake, you...

answers.text: Admit it and learn — that's the path to growth
Analyze why the plan failed and do better next time

question: What do you do in your free time?

answers.text: Meditate, train, help others
Sharpen my skills and plan the next steps

question: You're on Tatooine. Your stance on slavery here?

answers.text: Fight it at any cost — it's a despicable evil
Sad, but that's the local reality. Not my jurisdiction

question: Galactic Republic or Galactic Empire?

answers.text: Republic — democracy and freedom are worth defending
Empire — order and stability matter more than the illusion of freedom

question: You're invited to join the Jedi Order. You...

answers.text: Accept — serving the Force and the Galaxy is an honor
Decline — too many restrictions and rules

question: The destruction of Alderaan is...

answers.text: A horror and war crime — no goal justifies this
Brutal, but an effective demonstration of power

question: You have a chance to destroy the Death Star, but thousands of Imperial soldiers will die. You...

answers.text: Act — stopping a weapon of mass destruction is more important
Look for a way to do it without casualties first

question: What inspires you?

answers.text: Love for those close to me and the desire to make the world better
Ambitions, achievements, and the desire to leave a mark in history

question: Your leadership style?

answers.text: Inspire and support the team — we're stronger together
Clear orders and high standards — results matter most

question: How do you treat strangers?

answers.text: Everyone deserves a chance — I don't judge by appearance
I trust only the proven — excessive openness is dangerous

question: Your best friend made a terrible mistake. You...

answers.text: Support them, help fix it, and move forward together
Tell them the hard truth straight to their face

question: What matters more — freedom or security?

answers.text: Freedom — without it, security becomes a cage
Security — freedom without safety is just chaos

question: The Dark Side offers to bring back a dead loved one. You...

answers.text: Refuse — death is part of the Force, it can't be cheated
Accept — I'll do anything for those I love

question: You sense the Dark Side gives more power. You...

answers.text: Resist — power without wisdom destroys
Explore it — why refuse greater power?

question: Someone tells you: 'Your emotions are your strength'. You...

answers.text: Skeptical — uncontrolled emotion leads to mistakes
Agree — I won't suppress what makes me stronger

question: You see a vision of a terrible future. Your reaction?

answers.text: Accept it as a warning and proceed carefully
Do everything possible to prevent it at any cost

question: You can read other people's minds. You...

answers.text: Don't do it without permission — privacy is sacred
Use it — knowledge is power, sentiments are irrelevant

question: Before a great battle, you...

answers.text: Plan to minimize casualties and seek a peaceful solution
Develop a plan to win at any cost

question: An ally betrays you at a critical moment. You...

answers.text: Adapt to the situation and find new paths
Make sure they regret their decision

question: Your enemy is twice as strong as you. You...

answers.text: Find weaknesses, use wit and tactics instead of direct combat
Accept the challenge — retreat is shameful

question: How do you feel about espionage?

answers.text: Only as a last resort and only against a real threat
A useful tool — the better informed wins

question: Your reaction to an unexpected defeat?

answers.text: Analyze the mistakes, recover, and move forward with new knowledge
Anger motivates me to grow stronger so I never lose again

question: What kind of person do you want to be remembered as after death?

answers.text: Someone who protected the weak and left the world better
Someone who changed the galaxy and left an unforgettable mark

question: What does 'being good' mean to you?

answers.text: Acting honestly, with compassion and respect for all
Being effective — weak goodness helps no one

question: You meet a Sith Lord you respect. You...

answers.text: Stay true to my principles — respect doesn't mean agreement
Listen to his philosophy — wisdom has no color

question: If the Force chose you — where would it direct you?

answers.text: To protect those who cannot protect themselves
To the heights of power, to rebuild the galaxy in my image

question: Your final choice before death?

answers.text: Forgive even enemies — and become one with the Force
Take as many enemies as possible with me — to the end

question: You're in Mos Eisley Cantina. Someone threatens you. You...

answers.text: Try to defuse the situation with words first
Shoot first — better not to risk it

question: Your droid did something wrong. You...

answers.text: Recalibrate it and patiently explain what went wrong
Penalize it — mistakes have consequences even for droids

question: You're invited to join the Rebellion or the Empire. You...

answers.text: Rebellion — freedom and resistance to tyranny above all
Empire — order, resources, and real power

question: You find a Dark Side Force artifact. You...

answers.text: Destroy it or hand it to a secure Order vault
Study it — knowledge of the enemy gives an advantage

question: A Mandalorian offers you a weapon in exchange for a favor. You...

answers.text: Ask what the favor is and whether it conflicts with my values
Agree immediately — good weapons rarely come free

question: Your stance on slavery?

answers.text: Absolute evil that must be eradicated immediately
Tragic reality — first become strong enough to change the system

question: You're asked to spy on a friend for the 'greater good'. You...

answers.text: Refuse — friendship and trust cannot be sacrificed
Agree — in the big game, personal ties are secondary

question: If you could rewrite the Jedi Code, you would...

answers.text: Allow more humanity — love and empathy make us stronger
Make it stricter — discipline above everything

question: Your enemy asks for a truce. You...

answers.text: Listen — even enemies may have a valid point
Don't trust it — it's a trap or a stalling tactic

question: You captured an enemy commander. You...

answers.text: Take them prisoner and follow the rules of captivity
Interrogate by any means — we need the information

question: What trait are you most proud of?

answers.text: Compassion — I always try to understand others
Determination — I don't stop before obstacles

question: Your master betrays you. You...

answers.text: Suffer, but try to understand their motives
Cut all ties — a master's betrayal is unforgivable

question: Your favorite Star Wars planet?

answers.text: Naboo or Coruscant — civilization and beauty
Mustafar or Korriban — power and mystery

question: You see someone's food being taken by force. You...

answers.text: Intervene immediately — even if it's risky
Assess the situation before acting — rash actions cause harm

question: Who is a true hero to you?

answers.text: Someone who sacrifices themselves for others without glory
Someone who achieves the impossible by sheer force of will

question: You can stop a conflict only by deceiving both sides. You...

answers.text: Find another solution — peace built on lies is fragile
Do it — stability matters more than perfect methods

question: How do you view the Jedi Order overall?

answers.text: With respect — imperfect, but an important guardian of peace
Critically — their pride and blindness doomed the Republic

question: You need to pass through enemy territory. You...

answers.text: Seek a diplomatic pass or an alternate route
Break through by force — speed and aggression decide

question: A child asks you to teach them the Force. You...

answers.text: Teach responsibly — wisdom first, then technique
Teach powerful techniques immediately — let them choose their own path

question: What does 'being free' mean to you?

answers.text: Acting in accordance with your values without coercion
Having enough power so no one can stop you

question: After a great victory, you...

answers.text: Honor the fallen and think about the next step
Enjoy the moment of triumph — victory deserves celebration

question: You're called to join a coup against a tyrant. You...

answers.text: Join — tyranny cannot stand forever
Assess the odds first, then decide

question: How do you perceive death?

answers.text: As part of the natural cycle of the Force — not an enemy
As an enemy to defeat or push as far away as possible

question: You're offered immortality, but the price is your soul. You...

answers.text: Refuse — immortality without a soul is not life
Consider it — immortality gives infinite time for achievement

question: You know that lying could save thousands. You...

answers.text: Tell the truth and find another way to save them
Lie without hesitation — thousands of lives outweigh my honesty

question: What matters more — order or justice?

answers.text: Justice — unjust order is worse than chaos
Order — without it, justice is impossible

question: You're on a team where everyone is stronger than you. You...

answers.text: Find my unique role and contribute what I can
Train relentlessly to become the strongest on the team

question: You're offered leadership of a Dark Order. You...

answers.text: Refuse — not my path
Consider it — power over such an organization offers vast possibilities

question: You receive an order to destroy an entire planet. You...

answers.text: Refuse and rebel against this order
Execute it — strategic necessity is sometimes horrific

question: What is attractive about the Dark Side?

answers.text: Nothing — it seduces, but leads to self-destruction
Its directness — it's honest about the nature of power

question: You find out you've been used. You...

answers.text: Confront honestly and decide whether to continue the relationship
Make the manipulator regret their decision

question: You're asked to betray the Order to save your loved one. You...

answers.text: Find a way to save them without betrayal — both paths aren't the only ones
Betray — no organization is worth more than someone I love

question: Your reaction to an unjust law?

answers.text: Fight to change it through legitimate means
Break it — an unjust law has no moral authority

question: You're the only witness to a Jedi's crime. You...

answers.text: Report it to the Council — no one is above the law, even a Jedi
Hide it — the Order's reputation matters more than one incident

question: What scares you most?

answers.text: Becoming what I fought against my entire life
Being powerless against a threat I couldn't stop

question: You meet someone stronger than you in the Force. You...

answers.text: Try to learn from them — strength is no reason for rivalry
Study their weaknesses — every advantage is temporary

question: You're unjustly thrown in prison. You...

answers.text: Seek a legal way out and appeal the verdict
Escape — unjust imprisonment doesn't obligate me to stay

question: Your reaction to a stranger's suffering?

answers.text: Help immediately — indifference contradicts my nature
Assess the situation — their motives may not be honest

question: If you could speak with Darth Vader, you would...

answers.text: Try to find the spark of Anakin Skywalker still alive in him
Study his tactics and power — the greatest always has something to teach

question: What does 'victory' mean to you?

answers.text: When everyone can live in peace and dignity after the battle
When the goal is achieved and the enemy is no longer a threat

question: You're cursed as a traitor after making the right decision. You...

answers.text: Bear this cross — truth matters more than reputation
Force people to see the truth — even by force if necessary

question: Your ideal ending to a great galactic saga?

answers.text: Peace, restoration, and reconciliation between all sides
Total victory and a new order established by a strong hand

question: You find an enemy's diary and see — they suffered. You...

answers.text: Pause — even enemies are people with pain and their own truth
Look for useful information — I'll process emotions later

question: What weapon would you fight with?

answers.text: A lightsaber — the weapon of skill and the Force
A dual blade or Dark Force weapon — maximum power

question: What would you say to Emperor Palpatine?

answers.text: I will never join — no power is worth betraying humanity
What are you offering? — I'll hear the terms before answering

question: After a long war, peace has come. You...

answers.text: Rejoice and help rebuild what was destroyed
Stay alert — peace is often just a pause before the next storm
